resources.purpose: 2D clinical image + patient/lesion attributes for image/tabular fusion

resources.limitations: Publisher download endpoints returned 403; the public Kaggle copy carries matching attribution terms. Verify original counts/joins before training; split by patient, not image. This is the original PAD-UFES-20, not restricted PAD-UFES-20+.
2D published teaching images; not DICOM volumes or an outcome-linked longitudinal report corpus. Group identical images across question splits; patient independence is not established.

resources.purpose: 2D mammography classification, clinical-table fusion and lesion localization data
resources.licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 (Kaggle distribution); retain original TCIA attribution and terms
resources.limitations: JPEG conversion of CBIS-DDSM, not native CT/MRI or 3D mammography. Verify full/crop/ROI coordinate correspondence and patient disjointness before detection training.

resources.purpose: paired biomedical image/text feature encoder for research fusion and retrieval
resources.limitations: Downloaded weights are not an activated MedTwin model, a lesion detector, or clinical validation. Local research initialization/feature checks are separate from task-specific training.
